subject: MAP: Helio evaluation & pricing alignment - pricing & commit
messages:
From: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@heliohealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Helio evaluation & pricing alignment

Evelyn / team —

Thanks again for the demo last week. I attached the latest MAP (Helio_MAP_v3.xlsx) that shows our target timeline and the success criteria for the POC. Procurement and finance have started the internal review — their two asks for a preliminary commercial path:

- Range of committed spend options for 6/12/24 months (ballpark numbers are fine).
- Any credit/intro offers for proof-of-value (we generally look for a 60–90 day POC with credits).
- Details on security evidence (SOC2 summary attached) so our InfoSec can clear the vendor.

Our internal window to finalize terms and get procurement signoff is the week of Aug 9. Can you share a recommended commit/credit combination and who on your side needs to approve discounts?

Also tagging Procurement: procurement@heliohealth.com — they may send a formal SOW template.

Thanks,
Ari Kaplan
Director, Platform Engineering
Helio Health Systems

Attachments: Helio_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2-Summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari.kaplan@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Helio evaluation & pricing alignment

Ari — thanks for the MAP and the SOC2 snapshot. This is helpful.

Quick update from my side: we ran the usage estimate against the MAP and have two recommended starter paths depending on your risk profile:

1) Conservative: 6-month commitment, 250k annualized token spend equivalent (monthly invoiced), plus $25k in POC credits applied over first 90 days.
2) Growth: 12-month commitment, 600k annualized token spend equivalent, plus $40k in POC credits over 90 days, with a 10% committed-rate rebate at renewal if actual usage exceeds 110%.

Neha / Karthik — can you confirm who needs to sign off on each credit tier? For the Growth option we will require finance approval for the $40k credits and a formal credit memo.

Ari — if either looks acceptable I can put both options into a quick one-pager and route the discount approval. Also let me know the preferred start date for the POC; you mentioned early Aug in the call.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: (415) 555-0192

--

Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Helio evaluation & pricing alignment

Evelyn — looping in finance pathing.

For clarity:
- Credit approvals up to $15k can be approved by Sales Ops. Anything above requires a Credit Memo and approval from Revenue Ops + Finance (APAC/US split approvals but Helio is US so Revenue Ops + CFO approval).
- For a $25k POC credit we can do an expedited approval (Sales Ops + RevOps). For $40k we need RevOps sign-off and a formal credit memo; expect 48–72 hours to turn.
- Discount/committed-rate rebates at renewal need Legal to approve T&Cs and Revenue Ops to confirm accounting treatment.

Action items I can take now: prepare a one-page credit package and a draft credit memo template that Karthik can circulate to Finance. Please attach the usage assumptions (from your MAP) and the expected start date for the POC.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Helio evaluation & pricing alignment

Evelyn / Neha / Ari —

I can coordinate the credit memo and finance touchpoints. A couple of asks to make the approvals straightforward:

1) Ari — which option do you want us to draft? Conservative (6m / $25k credits) or Growth (12m / $40k credits)? If Growth, please confirm the nominal committed monthly spend that corresponds to the 600k annualized token equivalent — we will map that to an ARR number for Finance.
2) Evelyn — please include projected token distribution across inference endpoints (chat vs embeddings) if possible; Finance wants the cost center mapping.
3) Neha — once Evelyn sends the one-pager, I will assemble the credit memo and route to RevOps + Finance. I expect RevOps review in 24 hours and Finance 48–72 hours thereafter.

For speed, I created a draft DocuSign envelope (https://redwood.app/sign/DocuSign-88512) and the hubspot deal is at https://app.hubspot.com/deal/88512 — once terms are agreed I will push the contract to signature.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Helio evaluation & pricing alignment

Evelyn / Karthik / Neha —

Thanks — after reviewing internally Procurement prefers the Growth path assuming we can finalize the $40k POC credit and the 12-month committed spend numbers stated (they want the rebate language at renewal captured). We will aim to start the POC on Aug 16, pending your contract/credit memo.

A couple of final asks from our side:
- Can you add a 30-day clawback clause to the POC credit language (if the POC is canceled before 30 days, credit is void)?
- We will need the SOC2 package for procurement to archive with our vendor assessment team (SOC2-Summary.pdf is helpful; if you have the full attestation please send).

We are ready to move forward on the Growth option. Please route whatever approvals are required and send the DocuSign link when ready. Procurement will review the SOW template once routed.

--
Ari Kaplan
Director, Platform Engineering
Helio Health Systems

Attachments forwarded: procurement@heliohealth.com forwarded a SOW template (see forwarded message)
